## U.S. Presidents Who Served Two Full Terms (8 years)  
*(including presidents who served two non‑consecutive terms)*  

| # | President | Years in Office | Party Affiliation | Notes |
|---|-----------|-----------------|-------------------|-------|
| 1 | **George Washington** | 1789‑1797 | *Independent* (often grouped with Federalists) | First president; no formal party. |
| 2 | **Thomas Jefferson** | 1801‑1809 | Democratic‑Republican | Early “anti‑Federalist” party. |
| 3 | **James Madison** | 1809‑1817 | Democratic‑Republican | 2nd‑most‑served Democratic‑Republican. |
| 4 | **James Monroe** | 1817‑1825 | Democratic‑Republican | 3rd to 4th “Era of Good Feelings.” |
| 5 | **Andrew Jackson** | 1829‑1837 | Democratic | Founder of the modern Democratic Party. |
| 6 | **Grover Cleveland** | 1885‑1889 & 1893‑1897 | Democratic | Only president with *non‑consecutive* terms. |
| 7 | **Ulysses S. Grant** | 1869‑1877 | Republican | Post‑Civil‑War Republican. |
| 8 | **Theodore Roosevelt** | 1901‑1909 | Republican | Progressive‑era Republican. |
| 9 | **William Howard Taft** | 1909‑1913 | Republican | Last president elected by the Republican Party until 2000. |
|10 | **Woodrow Wilson** | 1913‑1921 | Democratic | First president elected with a “New Freedom” platform. |
|11 | **Calvin Coolidge** | 1923‑1929 | Republican | “Business‑Friendly” Republican. |
|12 | **Franklin D. Roosevelt** | 1933‑1945 | Democratic | Elected *four* times; still the only four‑term president. |
|13 | **Dwight D. Eisenhower** | 1953‑1961 | Republican | Post‑World‑War II Republican. |
|14 | **Ronald Reagan** | 1981‑1989 | Republican | Conservative‑era Republican. |
|15 | **Bill Clinton** | 1993‑2001 | Democratic | 1990s Democratic. |
|16 | **George W. Bush** | 2001‑2009 | Republican | Early‑2000s Republican. |
|17 | **Barack Obama** | 2009‑2017 | Democratic | 21st‑century Democratic. |

### Quick Party‑Affiliation Summary
| Party | Presidents (8‑year terms) | Years (approx.) |
|-------|---------------------------|-----------------|
| Independent/Federalist | George Washington | 1789‑1797 |
| Democratic‑Republican | Thomas Jefferson, James Madison, James Monroe | 1801‑1825 |
| Democratic | Andrew Jackson, Grover Cleveland, Woodrow Wilson, Bill Clinton, Barack Obama | 1829‑1837, 1885‑1889 & 1893‑1897, 1913‑1921, 1993‑2001, 2009‑2017 |
| Republican | Ulysses S. Grant, Theodore Roosevelt, William Howard Taft, Calvin Coolidge, Dwight D. Eisenhower, Ronald Reagan, George W. Bush | 1869‑1877, 1901‑1909, 1909‑1913, 1923‑1929, 1953‑1961, 1981‑1989, 2001‑2009 |
| Democratic (four‑term) | Franklin D. Roosevelt | 1933‑1945 |

> **Note:**  
> • The Democratic‑Republican Party evolved into the modern Democratic Party in the 1820s.  
> • Franklin D. Roosevelt’s four terms are historically noteworthy, but he still qualifies as a “two‑term” (and more) president.  
> • Grover Cleveland is unique in that his two terms were non‑consecutive; he still served a total of eight years.

These are all presidents who completed at least two full presidential terms (or two separate four‑year terms) and their political affiliations at the time they were elected.
